fieldData.main-content:
Exciting news for Radix: XRD is now available for purchase using fiat (Mastercard, Visa, SEPA) or a range of cryptocurrencies direct to your Radix Desktop Wallet.

‍

This means there is now a quick and easy way to access the 130+ dApps and 750+ tokens in the burgeoning Radix ecosystem. New to Radix and want to use a cDEX, participate in a prediction market, acquire your favorite NFT, or stake to secure the network? Now just a few clicks away. 

‍

So how does it work?

Radix Tokens Jersey Limited has partnered with Switchere to offer a “Buy XRD” widget. When you click on the widget, you will be taken to the Switchere site, agree to their terms of services, and buy XRD directly from them.

The widget is available on the www.radixdlt.com website, can be shared by link, and can be added by anyone in the Radix community to their own site. 
‍

To acquire XRD all you need to do is:

  1. Sign up to Switchere
  2. Enter your card details and Radix account address

and like magic - XRD is in your account (with purchase limits depending on your level of verification).
‍

Click here to get started.

‍

‍

The availability of XRD through Switchere is just one more step along the road to Babylon and toward achieving the Radix vision of a radically better financial system. 

So head to www.radixdlt.com now to obtain XRD and join the thousands of others who share the beliefs, vision, and commitment to help people live the lives they imagine, powered by DeFi.
